title: Accepting Bitcoin for Ebook Sales: A Step-by-Step Deployment Guide
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and digital downloads with automated crypto delivery — no platform middleman, no payout delays, no geographic filter.

content.text: In Kenya, digital creators selling ebooks face a harsh reality: the conventional payment platforms they rely on, like Stripe and PayPal, are unavailable or severely restricted. This leaves them struggling to monetize their work, with limited access to the global market. The problem is not just financial exclusion, but also the loss of creative autonomy. By using these platforms, creators are forced to surrender their assets, data, and decision-making authority to third-party gatekeepers. It's time to break free from this dependency and build a more sovereign commerce infrastructure – one that puts creators in control of their own revenue streams. In this guide, we'll show you how to accept Bitcoin for ebook sales using a self-sufficient payment and delivery pipeline.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to a successful sovereign commerce infrastructure is to decentralize payment processing and automate the delivery of digital products. By using a combination of open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, you can create a self-sufficient payment pipeline that doesn't rely on third-party platforms. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a fundamental redesign of the way you collect payments and deliver products to your customers. It's a more secure, more reliable, and more efficient approach to e-commerce – one that puts you in control of your own revenue streams.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can start deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure, you'll need to gather a few essential tools and resources. This includes a domain name, a web hosting service, a code editor, and a basic understanding of JavaScript and HTML. You'll also need to sign up for a NOWPayments account, which will enable you to accept Bitcoin payments for your ebooks. With these resources in hand, you'll be ready to start building your self-sufficient payment pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The first step in setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is to create a GitHub Pages site for your ebook storefront. This will provide a simple and secure way to host your ebook files and display them to your customers. Next, you'll need to set up a Cloudflare Workers script that will automate the delivery of your ebook files to customers who have made a payment. Finally, you'll need to integrate your NOWPayments account with your Cloudflare Workers script, so that payments can be processed automatically.
A sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a one-time investment, but a continuous process of innovation and improvement.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up and tested, it's time to go live and start processing transactions. To do this, you'll need to deploy your Cloudflare Workers script and GitHub Pages site to a production environment. You'll also need to test your payment flow to ensure that it's working correctly. With your sovereign commerce infrastructure in place, you'll be able to start accepting Bitcoin payments for your ebooks and delivering them automatically to your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign commerce infrastructure is up and running, you'll need to think about scaling your operations to meet the demands of growing customer base. This may involve upgrading your hosting service, optimizing your Cloudflare Workers script, or integrating additional tools and services into your payment and delivery pipeline. With a self-sufficient commerce infrastructure, you'll have the flexibility to scale your operations in response to changing demand, without being held back by third-party platforms or payment gateways.

Your Deployment Checklist

Here's a concrete checklist of steps to help you deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure and start accepting Bitcoin payments for your ebooks:

1. Set up a GitHub Pages site for your ebook storefront.
2. Create a Cloudflare Workers script that automates the delivery of your ebook files.
3. Integrate your NOWPayments account with your Cloudflare Workers script.
4. Deploy your Cloudflare Workers script and GitHub Pages site to a production environment.
5. Test your payment flow to ensure that it's working correctly.
6. Start processing transactions and delivering ebooks to your customers.
7. Monitor your operations and scale your infrastructure as needed.
8. Consider upgrading your hosting service or optimizing your Cloudflare Workers script to improve performance and reliability.
With a self-sufficient commerce infrastructure, you'll have complete control over your revenue streams and can respond quickly to changing market conditions.
